toolboxes.name: Finance Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Finance Toolbox: volatility measurement from daily and intraday prices, high-frequency covariance, ARIMAX models, GARCH-type, stochastic volatility and regime switching models, point processes, time-series forecasting, Bayesian asset-pricing factor models, portfolio optimisation, loss risk measures, extreme value analysis, and simulated limit order book markets.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Economics Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Economics Toolbox: business cycle filters, discrete-time stochastic volatility models, DSGE models, VAR/VECM systems, heterogeneous-agent models, continuous-time macro-finance and game theory.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Epidemiology Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Epidemiology Toolbox: inference of epidemiological parameters, inference on contact networks, compartmental models (SIR, SIS, SEIR, SIRS, SEIRD), branching processes, epidemics on networks and coinfection.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Self-Study: Learn and Practise
toolboxes.description: Turn your slides, notes and PDFs into what helps you study: more problems with their solutions, a topic explained in depth, a summary of a paper, prose and audio from slides, or slides from a long text. For students, and for teachers preparing their classes.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Core Mathematics Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Core Mathematics Toolbox: symbolic math, linear algebra, nonlinear systems, automatic and numerical differentiation, numerical integration, and ordinary and partial differential equations.
toolboxes.author: Pollis
